text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here!
The generational clash: T.M. Opera O vs. Jungle Pocket!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... can Jungro win?
Her opponent is Opera O, after all,
and what worries me even more is...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's one thing I wanna ask you.
It's about the rumors going around.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Opera will probably run in the Arima Kinen, too. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Why did you choose to challenge the Japan Cup?
Everyone says it's unwinnable."

It made sense for Umamusume fans to doubt Jungle Pocket's victory.
Because...
Many Umamusume have challenged the Japan Cup in their Classic Year. But...

Most have tasted defeat. Even among the Umamusume
who conquered the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) under the same conditions,
not a single one has ever won here.
I didn't simply fall for T.M. Opera O's provocation. The reason I chose this place is—
choice_data_list: Because you are the 'Ogre of Battle Cries'
Because you are — the 'Ogre of Battle Cries'

text_block_list.text:
"Jungle Pocket's compatibility with Tokyo Racecourse is
top-notch. Perhaps under these conditions――"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I see, track aptitude, huh. What are the chances of winning?
choice_data_list: Even so, looking at past precedents... it'll be quite tough.

text_block_list.text:
Looking at past data, and factoring in
T.M. Opera O's sheer strength, that's only natural, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see, it was rough, huh.
Well, don't worry about the past.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Precedent doesn't apply to me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Pokke-san.
Welcome to my theater.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to workin' with ya~

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let's do this, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good to see you.
Though Opera O, I can't just let what you said slide.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "This Tokyo Racecourse is my turf. It ain't your damn theater."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
However, to truly thrill this crowd, one needs their own theatrical troupe. And yet...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's only you on that side! Not a single other classmate!
What a lonely generation!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As a representative of that generation,
can you break through it?
My "Wall of Wotan".

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Whoa... say what?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The "Wotan Wall"! Countless Umamusume
have bounced right off this obstacle in the past!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Every front-runner and chaser alike fell just inches short. Truly an aurora-colored divine wall!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You claim you can break through that?
A representative of the "weak generation" like you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Guh...

What T.M. Opera O said was no bluff at all.
In fact—

No matter how hard the pack challenged her,
she wouldn't yield. Her stamina is fearsome, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Opera O, I know all too well how tenacious you are, and that unbeatable narrow margin of yours. But...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: We're... not weak at all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The rivals I knew
weren't weak in the slightest. They were—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I never had the slightest desire to rule at the top
for a long time like you.
Everyone... everyone did...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: They bet everything on a single instant, turned themselves into light, and scattered into the wind. That's just the kind of folks they were...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I ran alongside them.
Scorched by their brilliance,
I fought my way all the way up here."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the "blazing light" of our generation!
That light will—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'll smash right through your thick, gigantic wall.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll achieve it. What I couldn't back when
I was running freestyle—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: National conquest! For the sake of the benefactor who first taught me how to run, too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, bold words, Pokke-san.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come on then! If that "light" of yours fails,
you will become nothing more than northern cinders!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"You're the one who's gonna turn to dust. I'll blow past you,
I'll blow right past you. Even if it costs me—my life."
(UOOOOOH!)

The excitement had reached its peak.
Thus, the stage was set.

Conquering the Japan Cup in the Classic Year.
And toppling a long-standing reign.
—A reckless, all-out brawl is about to begin.
